source.name: Warosu Database Backup 2026-07-15
source.short-desc: Database backup of warosu.org on 2026-07-15 in mysqldump (SQL statements) format
source.capture:
12 per-board mysqldumps as .sql.zst (3, biz, cgl, ck, diy, fa, ic, jp, lit, sci, vr, vt), 16.7GB compressed — the same board set as the 2023-03-15 and 2025-08-15 dumps, and the newest warosu backup on IA as of writing. Surveyed against archive.org/metadata: 16 files, 12 of them board dumps, no image payloads at all, so no download.exclude is needed.

DO NOT ASSUME THIS SUPERSEDES THE EARLIER DUMPS. Diffing 2023-03-15 against 2025-08-15 showed the newer one ADDED 83,238,889 posts but also LOST 178,739 that the older one had (jp 116,122, lit 42,661, sci 18,630, fa 1,326), invisible at board level because all 12 boards still appear. Warosu demonstrably drops content between snapshots. Until this dump is diffed the same way against 2025-08-15, all three must stay ingested, and none may be deleted on the strength of being older.

STATEMENT FORMAT IS NOT STABLE ACROSS WAROSU DUMPS and must be checked rather than assumed: 2023-03-15 emits one INSERT per row, 2025-08-15 uses extended inserts. That difference makes `grep -c '^INSERT INTO'` a row count on one and a statement count on the other (4,502,532 vs 1,393 for cgl), and makes file sizes non-comparable between dumps. Which form this one uses is UNVERIFIED.

The adapter is sql, over dumps `prepare` renames from original Fuuka (`parent`, no `thread_num`) to Asagi; that path has handled every warosu dump so far, timestamps are New-York wall time and are converted on ingest. Ghost posts (subnum != 0, replies made on warosu itself rather than 4chan) are skipped.

FIRST MEASURED 2026-08-22 by a full `ingest-all --count-only` pass over the re-staged out/ tree (two independent runs, byte-identical totals): 293,828,779 real posts + 410,654 ghosts = 294,239,433 rows read, 7,501,728 OPs, 12 boards, ZERO undated and ZERO unparsable lines. Per board (real posts): vt 109,607,018, jp 49,235,595, biz 42,754,584, lit 24,463,662, ck 18,020,808, sci 14,079,379, fa 11,502,607, vr 10,732,533, ic 5,598,237, cgl 4,630,262, diy 2,613,557, 3 590,537.

The `sql` adapter read it end to end with zero unparsable lines, so whichever statement form it uses, the reader handles it; the format itself remains unchecked and `grep -c` must still not be assumed to be a row count.

EVERY BOARD GREW against 2025-08-15 and that is NOT evidence of supersession. 2025 also grew on all 12 boards against 2023 and still dropped 178,739 real posts. A suggestive counter-signal: ghosts FELL from 386,779 (2023) to 382,520 (2025) before rising to 410,654 here, and ghosts are only ever added, so a snapshot holding fewer of them than its predecessor has demonstrably lost rows. The distinct-`num` diff against 2025-08-15 is still outstanding and is the only thing that settles it.
